crossRefs.note: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.
For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is…
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all…
where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person…
‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will…

translations.web: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.
translations.bsb: Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
translations.kjv: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
translations.asv: Yea and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days Will I pour forth of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy.
